title: Heat Kernel and Closed Geodesic Asymptotics for Nilpotent Coverings
summary: We establish all order long-time asymptotic expansions for heat kernels on nilpotent coverings and for prime closed geodesics in fixed central classes of nilpotent quotients of compact hyperbolic surfaces. The exact lattice-side input is the finite-dimensional rational Floquet-Bloch theory of the companion paper: rational Kirillov restrictions give exact finite-dimensional fibers, and a generalized Pytlik functional gives exact Fourier-inversion and normalized-trace identities. At a rational parameter $p/q$ the decomposition is exact, and the fluctuation of the fiber integrand is controlled…
